verdict.rationale: Zep's framework-integrations page lists LiveKit as a supported agent framework, and the docs claim sub-200ms context retrieval. They also document returning context directly from `thread.add_messages()` to save a round trip, which supports live-conversation latency. Only one of the three named voice platforms is evidenced, and the latency claims are generic vendor statements rather than voice-specific benchmarks. Missing for 10: documented Pipecat and ElevenLabs integrations, voice-pipeline-specific integration guides or latency budgets, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time performance.
